steps.title: Prepare Fluorobrite media (10% FBS)
steps.instruction: For 50 mL, combine 44 mL Fluorobrite DMEM, 5 mL fetal bovine serum, 500 µL penicillin/streptomycin solution, and 500 µL 4 mM L‑Glutamine.

steps.title: Prepare serum‑diluted Fluorobrite media (1% FBS)
steps.instruction: For 50 mL, combine 48.5 mL Fluorobrite DMEM, 500 µL fetal bovine serum, 500 µL penicillin/streptomycin solution, and 500 µL 4 mM L‑Glutamine.

steps.title: Prepare DNA‑lipid transfection mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile 1.7 mL Eppendorf tube, mix 200 ng telomere 2×MS2 gRNA plasmid, 50 ng MCP‑HaloTag plasmid, 50 ng dCas9‑GFP plasmid, 10 µL Opti‑MEM, 1 µL Lipofectamine 3000, and 0.5 µL p300 reagent. Incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Culture GIST‑T1 cells to confluence
steps.instruction: Seed GIST‑T1 cells in 5 mL Fluorobrite media at ~33 % confluence (≈400 000–600 000 cells) in a T25 flask. Incubate 1–2 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until 75–80 % confluence.

steps.title: Split and reseed GIST‑T1 cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, wash twice with 37 °C PBS, add 0.5 mL phenol‑red‑free trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 2–3 min at 37 °C until cells lift. Neutralize with 2 mL Fluorobrite media, then transfer cells to a new flask containing 5 mL Fluorobrite media (or continue to step A6).

steps.title: Seed cells in 8‑well imaging plates
steps.instruction: Plate 50 µL of trypsinized cells at 50 000 cells · mL⁻¹ into each well of a Lab‑Tek 8‑well plate. Add 400 µL Fluorobrite media to each well and culture as above.

steps.title: Pre‑transfection wash and media addition
steps.instruction: ≈15–17 h before imaging, aspirate media from each well, wash twice with 300 µL Fluorobrite media pre‑warmed to 37 °C. Add 100 µL Fluorobrite media supplemented with 4 mM L‑Glutamine, 1 % FBS, 1 % penicillin/streptomycin, and 200 µL Opti‑MEM. Incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add DNA‑lipid mix and incubate
steps.instruction: Dropwise add the entire DNA‑lipid mixture from step 3 to each well (avoid forceful pipetting). Incubate 15–17 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Label cells with PA‑JF646 dye
steps.instruction: Remove media, wash twice with serum‑diluted Fluorobrite media, then add 300 µL serum‑diluted Fluorobrite media containing 100 nM PA‑JF646. Incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Wash and incubate post‑labeling (repeat 4×)
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with Fluorobrite media, then incubate 30 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Repeat the dye‑label‑wash‑incubate cycle three additional times (total four cycles) to remove unbound PA‑JF646.

steps.title: Maintain cells until imaging
steps.instruction: Keep plates in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator until ready for microscopy.

steps.title: Calibrate microscope with TetraSpeck beads
steps.instruction: Dilute TetraSpeck microspheres 1:100 in DI water. Place 10 µL of the dilution on a cover glass or directly in an 8‑well plate well. On the microscope stage, excite beads with 640 nm and 488 nm lasers at ~1.75 mW (≈100 W · cm⁻²). Record a 100‑frame movie: frames 1‑50 with 640 nm excitation, frames 51‑100 with 488 nm excitation. Move the same bead field to a new position and repeat; perform at least five positions (≥50 beads total). Note: field of view 256 × 256 px, pixel size 160 nm.

steps.title: Configure laser sequence and power settings
steps.instruction: Remove bead sample and mount the 8‑well plate with transfected cells. Heat stage to 37 °C and set on‑stage CO₂ to 5 %. In the acquisition software, program a 10‑frame shutter sequence at 20 Hz: frame 1 = 488 nm (GFP), frame 2 = brightfield + 405 nm (photoactivation), frames 3‑10 = 640 nm (PALM). Set laser powers: 488 nm = 1.75 mW (≈100 W · cm⁻²), 640 nm = 17.5 mW (≈1 kW · cm⁻²), 405 nm adjustable between 1 µW and 251 µW (≈0.06–15 W · cm⁻²).

steps.title: Identify telomere puncta and acquire GFP frames
steps.instruction: Using minimal 488 nm exposure, locate nuclei showing telomere puncta. Acquire 200 consecutive GFP frames at 20 Hz for conventional imaging (keep exposure low to avoid bleaching).

steps.title: Perform PALM acquisition with photoactivation ramp
steps.instruction: Start 405 nm laser at 1 µW (≈0.06 W · cm⁻²) and increase by 5–10 µW every 1 000 frames until ~250 µW (≈0.015 W · cm⁻²) to maintain sparse activation. Record 15 000–30 000 frames at 20 Hz. Monitor cell morphology; stop acquisition if cells become round or show autofluorescence. For analysis, use only the first 5 000 frames (or fewer if morphology changes earlier).

steps.title: Repeat imaging for multiple cells
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 13–15 for additional cells; aim to collect data from ~10 cells to obtain sufficient statistics.
